title: PRactical Evaluation of Early-stage VENous diseases in correlation with occupaTIONal stress
summary: Patients with venous disease should be asked about their venous complaints and occupational physical strain using a questionnaire. The aim is to determine whether those affected have a particular occupational exposure in the early stages of venous disease. If this link exists, this will indicate the need for preventive measures in the workplace.

interventions.name:
-Patients at a vascular medicine practice specializing in the treatment of venous diseases
-Age > 18 years
-Have been employed for at least 12 months at the time of study enrollment
-Examination and treatment relevant to the study’s research question
-Identification relevant to the study’s resea

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Leg complaints 
- 18 years of age
- Occupation > 12 months
Exclusion criteria:
Lymphoedema of the legs, lipoedema, with known symptomatic heart failure (from NYHA II or EF<40%), chronic renal insufficiency stage G3b-5 according to KDIGO, PAVK stage IIa-IV according to Fontaine, peripheral polyneuropathy, relevant restrictions of mobility of the ankle, knee and hip joints and with relevant known musculoskeletal diseases
